name: Shanghai International Port (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai International Port (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the operation and management of ports in China. The company operates through container, bulk cargo, port logistics, and port services segment. It offers loading and unloading, storage, transit, land and water transportation of domestic and foreign goods. It also provides container unpacking, cleaning, repairing, manufacturing and leasing services; engages in the distribution and logistic information management.
